headline: No scored news; the week's gains begin to fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events, after two days of US safety news. As that news began to fade, Libertarian Utopia, Protector God and Reversion each slipped by a couple of hundredths. Horizon Balance is 2.5, down 0.03, still near its high for the month.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Libertarian Utopia, Protector God and Reversion each eased (-0.0) as earlier news faded.
